desc:
🔫 Merge guns into IMPOSSIBLE guns! Can you beat the Impossible Titan? ⛰️

Merge, shoot, upgrade, conquer! 💥

🧬 Merge any 2 guns into a brand-new crazy gun
⭐ Power up to 50-star guns from 8 different cases
🌍 45 Wild levels with epic bosses and climbing challenges
🏠 Upgrade your Base and Shooting Range to Level 20
⚔️ VERSUS: every gun is equal, and a CPU fights you if you're solo!
🎁 Weekly Rewards: come back every day for BIG rewards
🏅 Earn badges you can show on your profile
🎄 CHRISTMAS SALE: shop prices slashed!
🏰 NEW EVENT Nov 26 - Dec 26: Snow Fort Defense! Hold the fort to win prizes and a new event gun

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite so you never miss an update!
🎁 Join the Impossible Guns Group for an Epic Case, 3 free guns and 1K cash!

📜 UPDATE LOG
❄️ Nov 20: WINTER UPDATE! 10 new levels (36-45), 10 new bosses, 10 new guns, 50-star guns, Weekly Rewards, badges and a snowy hub
🎉 Nov 7: MEGA UPDATE! Levels 1-20 rebuilt, levels 31-35, new guns and hub portals
